requirements.description: Put HA1 first inside digest_data in the qop is None branch (curl style)
Put HA1 first inside digest_data in the else (qop) branch
Compute "response" directly from digest(...) of the joined digest_data, dropping the intermediate key_digest

label.evidence: httpx/_auth.py:283-287 (HA1 in both digest_data lists) and httpx/_auth.py:294 ("response": digest(b":".join(digest_data))). The key_digest line is removed.
label.notes: the author said in the thread that they agreed to make the change and added comments (# Following RFC 2069 and # Following RFC 2617/7616). The new tests verify the results against the RFC examples. The history was rewritten, so the commit order is ambiguous.
